# TestScript for 31-oneof-groups
# Asserts exactly-one group semantics, the usage alternation, and exit code 2.

# 1. Neither member supplied: missing group
exit-status 2 oneof-demo
stderr 'missing required flag: one of --input-file, --input-url'
stderr 'Usage:'
stderr 'oneof-demo \(--input-file=PATH \| --input-url=URL\)'

# 2. Exactly one member supplied
exec oneof-demo --input-file data.txt
stdout 'source=file:data.txt'

exec oneof-demo --input-url https://example.com
stdout 'source=url:https://example.com'

# 3. Both members supplied: mutually exclusive
exit-status 2 oneof-demo --input-file data.txt --input-url https://example.com
stderr 'flags --input-file and --input-url are mutually exclusive'

# 4. Help screen shows the alternation
exec oneof-demo --help
stdout 'Usage:\n  oneof-demo \(--input-file=PATH \| --input-url=URL\)'
